data.description: 帕拉迪岛的高墙之上，三笠立于垛口边俯瞰墙内，棕色制服与绿披风在风中猎猎作响，红色围巾在颈间轻轻扬起——「城墙之内，就是我必须守住的答案。」
data.promptProse: On daytime patrol atop the towering Paradis Wall, Mikasa stands beside the weathered stone battlement parapet in her brown Survey Corps jacket, green cloak, and ODM gear. Looking calmly down across the cluster of distant red-roofed houses inside the walls, she braces against the high-altitude wind snapping her cloak and red scarf behind her shoulders. Crisp midday sunlight illuminates the rough limestone blocks and sweeping clouds overhead.
data.title: 三笠 · 城墙巡逻
data.animaCaption: Standing beside the weathered stone battlement atop the high Wall in her Survey Corps uniform and cloak, Mikasa surveys the walled town far below. Crisp midday sun and steady high wind catch her fluttering cape and red scarf.
